firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever most recently traveled to a place with fewer than 100 inhabitants goes first.
clarifications: Give that player the starting player token and 6 coins. The next player clockwise receives 7 coins; the third and fourth players, if present, receive 8 each.
The token holder takes the first turn, then turns continue clockwise. Each turn chooses an action, advances a ship, and updates the action strips.
Solo play is different: the Wise Eminence receives the starting player token and acts first; the human starts with 7 coins.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently rode in a truck has the initial turn-order priority.
clarifications: Both Forklifts begin on space 0 of the Construction Track. Put the most recent truck rider’s Forklift on top.

Each phase uses the player farther along that track first; a stacked tie goes to the Forklift on top. Construction can be played simultaneously, but either player may request sequential turns. Resolve track movements as though turns were sequential.
Construction can change the track order before Trucking. The initial priority therefore does not guarantee the first Trucking turn.
houseFallback: If the group cannot distinguish who rode in a truck most recently, agree to choose the initial top Forklift randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.

gameName: Joan of Arc: Orléans Draw & Write
aliases: Joan of Arc Orleans Draw and Write
firstPlayerRule: Choose the multiplayer starting player randomly and give them the Follower bag.
clarifications: The bag holder draws the round’s Followers, then chooses the first Follower and takes its action. Choices continue clockwise.
The extra Followers give the starter three actions in a two-player round, or two actions with three to five players. The other players each get two or one, respectively.
After the round’s actions are finished, pass the bag clockwise for the next round. Refill an empty bag as instructed before passing it; the final emptying ends the game instead.
In solo play, the human starts and Joan takes the second turn.

clarifications: Play continues clockwise. A turn allows two plays, followed by drawing back up to the current draw limit, normally five cards.

gameName: Once Upon a Time: The Storytelling Card Game

clarifications: The first Storyteller begins the story. The starter card is drawn from the Story Deck; the instruction does not restrict it to Character cards.
